deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace leads a patient planeswalker deck supported by color-fixing artifacts, steady card draw, and a supporting creature board. Develop your mana first, then establish several threats while holding interaction for the plays that would undo your position. Dedicated finishers, chief among them Jace, Reality Sculptor, provide the closing plan alongside the larger creature threats. The deck gives up explosive starts and a dense planeswalker roster in exchange for dependable mana and a broader selection of Reality Fracture themes. For the buy list, prioritize Jace, Reality Sculptor, The Theorist, Jace Beleren, and Chandra, Chill of Compliance.

The quality model grades this deck at the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
